description: Explicit `/name` invocation of a user-authored subagent (docs/plans/custom-subagents.md P2). Requires a definition seeded at ~/.claude/agents/copse-eval-reviewer.md — see the plan's validation section. Proves the load-bearing assumption of the design: that a turn directive is enough to make the parent delegate through `task` rather than answering directly.
prompts: /copse-eval-reviewer review src/greet.ts and tell me what is wrong with it
